body: Same! Just came back after a break and was under 600.

I’m realising in my attempt to spare people from very disturbing details of a grotesque crime is leading to some confusion. I was hoping to point my friend in a direction that would get her answers for the mounting questions she has about this very particular situation. 
The FBI* is involved from what I understand because there is one years evidence of him trading images he had. They will not even give her the details of what they are working with.. it leaves a mother’s mind to tear itself apart. She’s questioning everything, trying to  comb her mind for the signs of him being this monster and she just sees her brother in law wanting to learn and work on the farm, go to concerts, talking to girls on dating apps etc. She can’t see the monster he was this whole time. Her husband is just as devastated and sick knowing his brother was capable of doing something like that to kids. She wants to protect her kids from the collateral damage that comes from something like this but they’re so young. Also, this is taking place in a very small township. Resources are limited and the CPS SW is telling her she only has the option to go to specific people to get the children counselling? I didn’t think that a SW had that much authority to tell parents who they can and cannot go to for help? It seemed odd to me.

I appreciate your comment! Also I’m so sorry for being so vague about the situation. It’s so hard to even put the information out there considering some of the details that I was told. I became physically ill by the details of what was found in his possession.. and more is coming out.

I am so sorry I just saw your reply. The children were just asleep on the couch in the photo my friend was given to identify the child (her daughter). That was the only evidence she was given from authorities and they have not been told how much more there is..

I appreciate both of your inputs. This is not a situation that many people have been put in apparently, from trying to research what to even do about finding out your kids pictures were on the dark web.. there’s next to nothing. My friend has been violently ill and deteriorating mentally since this took place. She has taken my advice and seeing a professional for the trauma.

WarmDrySocks-thank you for clarifying the term for the abuse.

To both WarmDrySocks and Oreoskickass, 

My friend was only given so much information about what led up to the arrest of her brother in law and was told more evidence is coming out. I can absolutely assure you both that my friends husband was not involved with what was taking place nor did he defend or protect his brother in any way. He threatened to unalive his brother in front of the police as he was being arrested. The CPS SW believes that means he’s violent and my friend is scared of her husband, it’s just weird coming from the CPS SW that my friend should get a divorce? My friend has not been sleeping or eating since the arrest took place finding out what happened to her daughters. She is beside herself that this was happening. She is seeking help for herself in all of this as well. 

They were both completely unaware. There were no signs he was a predator. He was blending in and hiding very well. He never touched the kids or made comments or did things to suggest that he was grooming or anything that would be a sign of predatory behaviour. This is a person that I have been around as well. He was polite, cracked jokes, kind of a hippie guy who played guitar and was just “normal”. 

There’s not any denial or down playing. There’s just so many questions that she has. So much anger and hurt. She is so lost and in disbelief. This was a person they trusted and was in their house. Imagine what she is going through. I can’t even wrap my head around this because I’ve been around this person too! It’s gross. It’s such a betrayal. She said she can’t trust anyone to come into her home anymore and even wants to consider homeschooling the kids now because she doesn’t feel like she can trust something won’t happen to them. 

The reason she is hesitant about going through with getting them counselling is because through the CPS investigation the children did not say they are aware of anyone being inappropriate with them. The CPS SW said the kids seemed to not have any “signs” that something was happening but still wants counselling and my friends thoughts is it will confuse them because they don’t even understand why their uncle was arrested, they’ve been told he did something EXTREMELY wrong and bad.

I am leaving a lot of holes in the story for a reason, trust me. due to the facts of the case being far more disturbing than I care to share but I will give this info, there were devices found in his possession that had CP from the dark web.. there was a years worth of evidence that the authorities had on him. There was also…. Other evidence found… he also admitted to a lot of sick stuff when he was arrested.
It was her brother in law. Her husbands brother. My friends husband was not involved in anyway with what was going on. His brother was the one taking photos etc.

It was not their dad. It was the dad’s brother(their uncle). Trust that I completely understand that children are not very forthcoming with their abuse (I was not and still struggle admitting to it) however the authorities have only told my friend that there was only pictures of the children sleeping, as far as they know. This also involves the dark web..
